turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class. Explain that.
Heard isn't answered. Why did the zero go in before anyone called me?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Then put your facts on the table, Hale. I'm waiting.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
Owen doesn't lie, and you've shown me nothing. Are you calling his mother a liar too, because the principal will hear that sentence today.
